data.gender_notes: Mufazzalah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'fazzala' which means 'to honor, to respect, or to exalt'. This name is often given to girls who are believed to be highly respected, revered, and exalted in their communities. The name Mufazzalah carries the meaning “Honored, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mufazzalah usually hope their child will grow to embody honored, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mufazzalah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
